cacheHttpResponses.description:
Enable caching of successful HTTP responses. When enabled, responses are
cached with a 60min TTL (reset on each cache hit) and served instantly
on identical requests. With 100% cache hit rates, endpoints can
automatically scale to zero while still serving cached responses,
optimizing both latency and cost. Cache hits are indicated by the
'x-cache: HIT' response header, and requests can bypass the cache using
'x-use-cache: false'.
Currently only available for HuggingFace Admins.

oneOf.description:
Scale on inference engine saturation: KV cache utilization, plus a waiting-queue
target so a burst is absorbed before the cache fills. Only valid for endpoints
running a vLLM or SGLang server with its metrics on, from a managed image or a
custom container launching one.

inferenceLoad.description:
Scale on inference engine saturation: KV cache utilization, plus a waiting-queue
target so a burst is absorbed before the cache fills. Only valid for endpoints
running a vLLM or SGLang server with its metrics on, from a managed image or a
custom container launching one.

ScalingScheduleEntry.description:
Scaling from `at` (UTC time of day) until the next entry, wrapping around midnight. Raising `minReplica` above 0
starts a scaled-to-zero endpoint; lowering `maxReplica` removes the replicas above it at once.
